observations.body: Meekness and spiritual weapons answer judgments of weakness. Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you. and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 10:1–6 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states meekness and spiritual weapons answer judgments of weakness. Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you. and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
